items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I believe Juan Tizol played the solo.

ctx.x: Yeah. A 78 I believe, right? Was it ever on LP? I don't remember ever seeing it.
I don't think so. No, I don't think it was ever on LP, because -- I believe Juan Tizol played the solo. I think it goes back that far.
